phase: Phase 4: 100M full matrix (10 arms x 3 seeds, 2.0B valid nt)
scope: 30 science runs (F1-F7 static track + P1-P3 BLT patch track) x seeds [17, 29, 43], each to 2.0B cumulative_valid_target_nt, validation-based checkpoint selection, frozen decoder, one-time sealed test, main likelihood/continuation/generation/efficiency tables.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All 30 science runs complete to the 2.0B nt budget (or reach a documented configuration-level FAIL gate with evidence)
acceptance_criteria.evidence_gate: p4_finalize.py --runs /mnt/cunyuliu/tokenizer-benchmark/runs: every cell status==DONE with final_nt>=budget_nt, OR explicit FAIL_CLOSED_WITH_EVIDENCE per cell

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No silent seed swap: each run's arm/seed match the frozen 10x3 matrix
acceptance_criteria.evidence_gate: p4_finalize.validate_manifest: arm==config arm, seed==config seed for all 30 cells

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every result traceable to a complete manifest (run_id, config, dataset/split hash, seed, GPU, params, exposure, checkpoint hash)
acceptance_criteria.evidence_gate: run_manifest.json per run with run_id, config.to_dict(), final_nt, best_checkpoint, params, cpu_fallback_count

acceptance_criteria.criterion: GPU-only execution enforced; no silent CPU fallback in training, validation, or evaluation
acceptance_criteria.evidence_gate: all manifests cpu_fallback_count==0; p4_eval/p4_generate assert fallback==0

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Validation-based checkpoint selection (best = lowest validation loss, never train loss / never test)
acceptance_criteria.evidence_gate: best_checkpoint chosen by min val_loss over checkpoints; test set never touched during selection

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Frozen decoder: generation uses the frozen pre-registered grid (conservative/balanced/exploratory) and frozen settings released before test
acceptance_criteria.evidence_gate: p4_generate.py DECODER_GRID + PRE_REGISTERED constants; grid frozen in git before sealed-test execution

acceptance_criteria.criterion: One-time sealed test: each arm/seed scored exactly once on the sealed test split (flat: full test; BLT: fixed homology-stratified subsample), metric per contract 3.5
acceptance_criteria.evidence_gate: p4_eval.py metric mapping (F1 next_base, F4/F5 overlap_path, F2/F3/F6/F7 canonical_path, P1-P3 next_base); BLT subsample manifest hash fixed

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Main likelihood/continuation/generation/efficiency tables produced (contract 3.7) with per-seed rows and seed means
acceptance_criteria.evidence_gate: p4_main_table.py output JSON + markdown; table A (internal controlled) per-arm means over available seeds

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Parameter/fairness census recorded for the 100M cohort (params within 2% tolerance, non-embedding matched within track)
acceptance_criteria.evidence_gate: run manifests params/non_embedding_params; cross-check against Phase 3 census

failure_branches: Any run with cpu_fallback_count>0 -> FAIL_CLOSED_WITH_EVIDENCE; rerun with GPU-only
Any run with seed slip -> FAIL; rerun with correct frozen seed
Any run not reaching budget within resource limits -> documented BLOCKED_RESOURCE, not silently downgraded to fewer seeds
